errors.text_span: HWER（隐藏-度量）、WER（词错误率）和SER（声学-度量）
errors.evidence: The expansions for HWER as "隐藏-度量" (hidden-metric) and SER as "声学-度量" (acoustic-metric) are not standard and appear to be invented. The figure does not provide these definitions.
The horizontal axis represents the metrics being measured (HWER-Dov, WER-Dov, SER-Dov), not the "特征类型" (feature type). The feature types are represented by the different colored bars in each group.
The y-axis scale has visible ticks from 0 to 20. Stating that the scale goes to 25 is inaccurate.
The y-axis does not have any units specified. The description invents the unit "百分比" (percentage).

errors.text_span: 第一个柱状图（蓝色）代表字母与词的混合特征，其高度约为 22%；第二个柱状图（橙色）代表仅对词的编码，其高度约为 7；第三个柱状图（绿色）代表仅对字母的编码，其高度约为 6。
errors.evidence: The description fails to identify the chart's grouped structure. It treats the chart as if it has only three bars in total, instead of three groups of three bars each. This leads to an incorrect description of the data, as it only reports one value per color, cherry-picked from different groups.

errors.text_span: 第一个柱状图（蓝色）代表字母与词的混合特征
errors.evidence: The legend for the blue bar shows a hyphen ("-"), not "字母与词的混合特征" (mixed feature of letters and words).

errors.text_span: 第二个柱状图（橙色）代表仅对词的编码
errors.evidence: The legend for the orange bar is "绝对位置编码" (absolute position encoding), not "仅对词的编码" (encoding for words only).

errors.text_span: 第三个柱状图（绿色）代表仅对字母的编码
errors.evidence: The legend for the green bar is "相对位置编码" (relative position encoding), not "仅对字母的编码" (encoding for letters only).
